diagnoses.failure: MapLibre Android fresh native location timed out

maplibreRun.lastKnownFixAgeAtInspection: about 10 hours 38 minutes by elapsed realtime

evidence.interpretation: Location is enabled and the emulator clock matches the host. During MapLibre runs, Android recorded a fused balanced registration but no delivered positions; its cached fix was stale. The adb geo-fix calls did not produce a fresh fix visible to the MapLibre provider path in the recorded OS history. This distinguishes the failure from location-mode disabled and from a fresh facade result.

diagnoses.cause: GPS emulator console input did not reach the configured fused SDK location provider; no new native locations were received. The facade freshness rejection was valid.
Runner invalidated the completed pack immediately before disconnecting and mistook cached byte completion for refresh completion. Restart now precedes separate online invalidation.

diagnoses.cause: Original raster URLs are outside native Mapbox tile-store offline support; fixture now uses supported hosted vector tiles and requires nonzero resources.

diagnoses.cause: Pinned wrapper declared/called the JavaScript method without native bindings on either platform; peer patch restores them.

diagnoses.cause: Xcode activity log captured write64() failed, returned -1 expected 6803048, errno=28 immediately before the Teleport archive write error. ENOSPC occurred during archive generation; later free-space readback did not rule out peak exhaustion.
diagnoses.scope: No iOS acceptance scenarios ran. Retry uses the same peer patch and single simulator architecture with reduced concurrency; original failure preserved here.
